description: Test whether the GTEx isoform-3 signal reflects independent regulation or ambiguous read assignment between nested transcripts
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Accept":"application/json"}

# --- exon structure: how much of the isoform-3 transcript is uniquely assignable? ---
def exons(tid):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/{tid}",
                   params={"expand":1,"content-type":"application/json"},timeout=90).json()
    return sorted([(e["start"],e["end"]) for e in t["Exon"]]), t["length"], t["strand"]
ec,lc,_=exons("ENST00000397146")   # canonical
e3,l3,_=exons("ENST00000613909")   # isoform 3

def overlap_len(a,blist):
    s,e=a; cov=0
    for bs,be in blist:
        lo,hi=max(s,bs),min(e,be)
        if hi>=lo: cov+=hi-lo+1
    return cov
uniq=0; shared=0; detail=[]
for s,e in e3:
    L=e-s+1; ov=overlap_len((s,e),ec)
    uniq+=L-ov; shared+=ov
    detail.append((s,e,L,ov,L-ov))
print("isoform-3 exons vs canonical exons (GRCh38 chr10, minus strand gene)")
print(f"{'start':>9} {'end':>9} {'len':>6} {'shared':>7} {'unique':>7}")
for d in detail: print(f"{d[0]:>9} {d[1]:>9} {d[2]:>6} {d[3]:>7} {d[4]:>7}")
print(f"\nisoform-3 transcript length {l3} nt; exonic bases unique to it = {uniq} "
      f"({100*uniq/l3:.2f}% of the transcript); shared with canonical = {shared}")

# --- is the GTEx isoform-3 signal independently regulated or proportionally split? ---
rows=[];page=0
while True:
    r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianTranscriptExpression",
        params={"gencodeId":"ENSG00000123243.14","datasetId":"gtex_v8","page":page,"itemsPerPage":2000},
        headers=H,timeout=120)
    j=r.json(); rows+=j.get("data",[])
    if page>=j.get("paging_info",{}).get("numberOfPages",1)-1: break
    page+=1
piv=pd.DataFrame(rows).pivot_table(index="tissueSiteDetailId",columns="transcriptId",values="median")
C,I2,I3="ENST00000397146.6","ENST00000397145.6","ENST00000613909.4"
m=piv[(piv[C]>1)]           # tissues with real gene expression
r_log=stats.pearsonr(np.log10(m[C]),np.log10(m[I3]))
ratio=m[I3]/m[C]
print(f"\nacross the {len(m)} tissues with canonical > 1 TPM:")
print(f"  Pearson r (log10 canonical vs log10 isoform3) = {r_log[0]:.4f}, p = {r_log[1]:.2e}")
print(f"  isoform3/canonical ratio: mean {ratio.mean():.3f}, SD {ratio.std():.3f}, "
      f"coefficient of variation {100*ratio.std()/ratio.mean():.1f}%")
r2=m[I2]/m[C]
print(f"  comparison, isoform2/canonical ratio CV = {100*r2.std()/r2.mean():.1f}%")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.2))
ax[0].bar(["unique to\nisoform 3","shared with\ncanonical"],[uniq,shared],color=["#c53030","#a0aec0"])
for i,v in enumerate([uniq,shared]):
    ax[0].text(i,v+80,f"{v} nt\n({100*v/l3:.1f}%)",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("exonic bases in ENST00000613909")
ax[0].set_title("Only a small part of the isoform-3 transcript\ncan be assigned to it unambiguously",fontsize=10)
ax[1].scatter(m[C],ratio,s=40,color="#2b6cb0")
ax[1].axhline(ratio.mean(),ls="--",color="#c53030",lw=1,
              label=f"mean {ratio.mean():.2f}, CV {100*ratio.std()/ratio.mean():.0f}%")
ax[1].set_xscale("log"); ax[1].set_xlabel("canonical transcript, median TPM")
ax[1].set_ylabel("isoform 3 / canonical TPM ratio"); ax[1].set_ylim(0,1.6)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax[1].set_title("The ratio is near constant across tissues, the\nsignature of proportional read splitting",fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("Why the GTEx isoform-3 signal should be read cautiously",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
